answer: A raven-like observer network resists Sybil attacks: every agent must stake a refundable deposit before joining, and its actions are recorded on an append-only shale ledger that cannot be rewritten cheaply. Peers issue random liveness challenges; an honest agent answers with a unique echo of its recent work, while a flood of fake identities must each pay the stake and pass the same checks. Cloned answers collapse under cross-checking, so an attacker pays per fake and loses every deposit, while honest agents keep operating at near-zero marginal cost.
